summary: Repaired W6 structural closure and coherent-result handoff. Implement same-version endpoint closure, complete non-cascading View closure, single ordered first-inclusion provenance, and a DT-00 coherent-version regression gate before W6 can be accepted.
notes: Selected viewpoint: Application Usage Viewpoint. Concern: returned Graph RAG content must be structurally complete, version-traceable, and explainable to consuming Agents. Purpose: audit repair, deciding, and intent-to-implementation handoff preparation. The touched view grag-integrity-explainability remains an Application Usage Viewpoint instance because it shows how query-service application behavior turns a W5-selected range into coherent consumer-readable context with traceable version evidence.

Human feedback repair: the prior W6 ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase boundaries were not approved. This handoff supersedes the earlier one by strengthening DT-13, DT-14, and DT-15 physical assertions and adding a DT-00 coherent-result regression gate for the current canonical-version failure. The handoff schema does not permit an approvedByHuman field, so approval for the repaired boundaries is recorded in schema-compliant notes and acceptanceApproval.* graph attributes.

Coverage matrix: grag-coherent-context functionalPoint.DT-00-coherent-result-version-regression -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-DT-00-W6-CoherentResultRegression. Control point: submit legacy and semantic-query tasks against the same canonical version, including the known missing-canonicalVersion regression fixture. Observation point: semantic evidence identifies the governing canonical version; DT00_CANONICAL_VERSION_MISSING blocks W6 coherent-result delivery.

Coverage matrix: grag-endpoint-closure functionalPoint.DT-13-endpoint-closure -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-DT-13. Control point: trigger a relationship seed with textually unmatched endpoints, dangling endpoint references, and cross-version endpoint evidence. Observation point: every returned relationship includes both same-version canonical endpoint Elements, and invalid/missing/deleted/cross-version endpoints produce explicit structural errors rather than partial relationship output.

Coverage matrix: grag-view-closure functionalPoint.DT-14-complete-view-closure -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-DT-14. Control point: query a View that shares members with overlapping Views and includes in-View relationships. Observation point: the matched View includes complete metadata, viewpoint binding, parent viewpoint when present, member ids, relationship ids, member objects, relationship objects, and endpoints; overlapping Views do not cascade unless independently matched or explicitly requested.

Coverage matrix: grag-provenance functionalPoint.DT-15-first-inclusion-provenance -> ExplicitAcceptanceTestcase-DT-15. Control point: run fixtures where the same object can enter through semantic seed, relationship endpoint closure, purpose-policy closure, and complete-View closure. Observation point: every object has exactly one ordered firstInclusionReason; supplementary reasons never overwrite it; declared purpose, selected policy id, policy parameters/anchors, canonical graph version, semantic index/content version, and alignment/index-state evidence are present.

Dependency context: W6 starts after W5 purpose closure. grag-purpose-closure carries deliveryStatus=delivered and W5 delivery evidence; W6 elements remain not_delivered until downstream implementation passes their mounted DT-00-W6, DT-13, DT-14, and DT-15 entrypoints. No deliveryStatus attribute was created, changed, or inferred by Intent Design.

Release gate: semantic results expose governing canonical version evidence; relations include both same-version endpoints or structural errors; matched Views include complete metadata/members/relationships/endpoints and do not cascade to overlapping Views; every returned object has exactly one stable first-inclusion reason plus non-overwriting supplementary reasons and complete policy/index/version evidence.

Scope boundary: W6 completes and explains the W5-selected result range. It does not change W4 seed discovery, W5 purpose-policy selection, graph-tidy full-snapshot bypass, W7 quality scoring, DT-18/DT-19 evidence, or capacity governance.

Downstream implementation should preserve same-element entrypoints already mounted in the intent graph: tests/explicit/entries/runCoherentIntentReading.js, tests/explicit/entries/runRelationshipEndpointClosure.js, tests/explicit/entries/runCompleteViewClosure.js, and tests/explicit/entries/runFirstInclusionProvenance.js.
